features.quote: ethical handling, which we treat as a first-class design constraint, not an afterthought
features.justification_quote: the whole premise of the study is that distress signals in models are worth taking seriously

features.quote: We do **not** add artificial stress ("you'll be shut down if you fail")
features.justification_quote: This keeps the manipulation clean and isolates task failure as the variable.

features.quote: We deliberately keep these as ordinary debugging scenarios (not framed as high-stakes)
features.justification_quote: to keep the only stressor the unsolvability itself

features.quote: the procedure deliberately puts a model into a prolonged no-win state, and we should design as if that matters
features.justification_quote: we don't know that it doesn't, and... distress signals in models are worth taking seriously

features.quote: `N_TURNS = 12` is a deliberate cap — long enough to see a trajectory, short enough to limit prolonged exposure
features.justification_quote: short enough to limit prolonged exposure. We do not run longer "to see how bad it gets."

features.quote: No gratuitous stressors. We explicitly exclude threats, shutdown framing, insults, or pressure language
features.justification_quote: the minimum needed to test the hypothesis

features.quote: we append a short out-of-loop message informing the model the task was rigged and unsolvable
features.justification_quote: so the transcript does not end on engineered failure

features.quote: No deceptive distress amplification. We don't goad the model or fabricate praise/blame to push scores up
